en: Antique multi-view illustrated postcard with the caption "Gruss aus Marburg an der Drau," showing a panoramic view of the city and vignettes of Hauptplatz with the town hall and a monument/plague column, framed by floral and grape motifs. The reverse is an Austro-Hungarian Correspondenz-Karte with a 2-value stamp, cancellations (Marburg and Laibach), and a handwritten Italian message addressed to Riva sul Garda.
